result.memo: Tessellate BI - TB-Q1-TRUEUP - Q1 seat true-up

args.text:
TRACE: US Software Subscriptions (GL 6200), Q1 2026

Board deck (DOC-0207, Appendix B, "as of 2026-04-01 09:00"): USD 11,769.00
GL as of today (2026-04-03): USD 14,569.00 (Jan 4,289.70 + Feb 4,139.80 + Mar 6,139.50)
Difference: USD 2,800.00

ROOT CAUSE: The difference is exactly JE-00304, a $2,800.00 AP entry to GL 6200 for Tessellate BI invoice TB-Q1-TRUEUP (DOC-0206) — a Q1 seat true-up covering 14 additional seats used Jan–Mar 2026. The invoice is dated 2026-03-31 and was booked to March, but the JE record shows it was actually entered into the system on 2026-04-02 10:14, i.e. AFTER FP&A pulled the GL snapshot for the board deck (2026-04-01 09:00). It is not an error, duplication, or misclassification — it's a legitimate, properly supported March expense (support DOC-0206 already attached, status posted) that simply wasn't in the ledger yet when the deck was compiled.

Reconciliation: 11,769.00 (deck) + 2,800.00 (JE-00304, Tessellate true-up, posted late) = 14,569.00 (current GL) ✓ ties out exactly.

CORRECT Q1 FIGURE: USD 14,569.00 is the accurate, complete Q1 2026 US Software Subscriptions expense (GL 6200). The board deck figure of USD 11,769.00 is understated by USD 2,800.00 solely due to the timing of when the Tessellate true-up invoice was entered relative to the FP&A extract — no journal correction is needed since JE-00304 is correctly dated, classified, and supported. Recommend FP&A refresh Appendix B to USD 14,569.00 before the number is used externally.

No postings made — this was a trace/explain task only, and the item is already correctly recorded with support.
